name: ms4-mcp-server
description: Machine Spirit 4 fused runtime MCP surface: identity, ethics, fused chat, voice readiness, model view, doctrine grounding, HiveMind inventory, local-image VLM analysis, Nibbles dry-run validation, full Hermes tool access, dependency/capability status, Hermes auto-update, Double Agent foreground/background coordination, and Windows desktop UI control.

tools.name: ms4.vision.analyze_local@v1
tools.description: Analyze a validated local image file through a HiveMind VLM.

tools.name: ms4.hermes.tool.call@v1
tools.description: Dispatch any available Hermes tool through MS4.

tools.name: ms4.runtime.deps.status@v1
tools.description: Report contained MS4 runtime dependency and capability status.

tools.name: ms4.hermes.version@v1
tools.description: Current vs latest Hermes version via public GitHub releases (cached ~1h).

tools.name: ms4.hermes.releases@v1
tools.description: Recent Hermes releases for the pin-a-version selector.

tools.name: ms4.hermes.update@v1
tools.description: Trigger an idempotent in-place Hermes upgrade (editable git checkout or PyPI wheel) in the MS4 contained .venv.

tools.name: ms4.hermes.update.status@v1
tools.description: Current/last Hermes upgrade phase and progress trail.

tools.name: ms4.double_agent.submit@v1
tools.description: Submit a Double Agent background job (foreground/background lobe coordination).

tools.name: ms4.double_agent.status@v1
tools.description: Current snapshot for one Double Agent job, including is_stale and last_safe_user_status.

tools.name: ms4.double_agent.list@v1
tools.description: List Double Agent jobs filtered by conversation_id and state.

tools.name: ms4.double_agent.events@v1
tools.description: Recent allowlisted lifecycle events for a job. Anti-hallucination: no raw model tokens.

tools.name: ms4.double_agent.cancel@v1
tools.description: Cancel a running Double Agent job.

tools.name: ms4.double_agent.mark_stale@v1
tools.description: Mark a Double Agent job stale and signal the worker to stop.

tools.name: ms4.desktop.status@v1
tools.description: Report Windows desktop-control readiness and active screen/window context.

tools.name: ms4.desktop.capture@v1
tools.description: Capture desktop screenshot metadata and optionally a base64 image.

tools.name: ms4.desktop.action@v1
tools.description: Perform local desktop UI actions through MS4.

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.time@v1
tools.description: Authoritative cluster time via hivemind.time.now@v1.

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.capability_matrix@v1
tools.description: Per-node capability matrix (GIMs, models, vGPU) via hivemind.capability.matrix@v1.

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.vms@v1
tools.description: VM inventory + GPU assignments snapshot (joins hivemind.vm.list + hivemind.vm.gpus).

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.vm.start@v1
tools.description: Start a HiveMind VM by id.

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.vm.stop@v1
tools.description: Graceful stop of a HiveMind VM (ACPI shutdown).

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.vm.screenshot@v1
tools.description: Capture a HiveMind VM's display.

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.apps@v1
tools.description: Cluster app inventory joined with status + metrics.

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.app.start@v1
tools.description: Start a HiveMind-registered app by id.

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.app.stop@v1
tools.description: Stop a HiveMind-registered app by id.

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.storage@v1
tools.description: Storage snapshot: pools + volumes + snapshots + status.

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.network@v1
tools.description: Network snapshot: networks + bridges + interfaces + attachments.

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.gpu@v1
tools.description: GPU mode capabilities + vGPU status + current availability.

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.voice_identities@v1
tools.description: List enrolled HiveMind voice identities.

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.approval.request@v1
tools.description: Request human approval via hivemind.human.approval.request@v1.

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.approval.status@v1
tools.description: Poll a previously-issued human approval request.

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.notify@v1
tools.description: Fire-and-forget operator notification (Telegram / log).

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.psykyo.benchmark.run@v1
tools.description: Run the PsyKyo Cyberpunk 2077 benchmark operator via hivemind.psykyo.benchmark.run@v1; promotion-gated by vlm_consensus.

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.psykyo.benchmark.gap@v1
tools.description: PsyKyo benchmark pre-flight gap-gate (reachability + visual boxes vs live UI). Side-effect-free.

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.psykyo.evidence.latest@v1
tools.description: Stable PsyKyo validation pointers and latest evidence summary.

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.psykyo.vlm_consensus@v1
tools.description: Reconcile saved HiveMind VLM/OCR sidecar artifacts (llama3.2-vision + qwen3-vl) before promotion.

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.oracle.status@v1
tools.description: HiveMind Oracle planner status snapshot.

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.oracle.chat@v1
tools.description: Ask the HiveMind Oracle planner to plan/reason about a request.

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.training.backends@v1
tools.description: Available HiveMind training backends.

tools.description: Start a HiveMind training job (LoRA / PEFT / forge).

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.training.status@v1
tools.description: Poll the status of a HiveMind training job.

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.adapters.list@v1
tools.description: List HiveMind-known adapters.

tools.description: Deploy an adapter to a model runtime.

tools.description: List configured HiveMind loadout profiles.

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.loadout.apply@v1
tools.description: Apply a HiveMind loadout profile (load/unload models).

tools.description: Deploy / start a HiveMind GIM by name.

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.inference.models@v1
tools.description: Model catalog via HiveMind MCP native handler.

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.inference.chat@v1
gated_by: none: bounded inference, no world mutation
tools.description: Direct chat completion via HiveMind MCP gateway.

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.logos.optimize@v1
tools.description: Run the Logos Machina prompt optimizer on a managed prompt.

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.services.enable@v1
tools.description: Enable a disabled Warden-managed service by name.

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.services.disable@v1
tools.description: Disable a running Warden-managed service by name.

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.services.restart@v1
tools.description: Restart a Warden-managed service via Warden's restart route.

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.jobs.cancel@v1
tools.description: Cancel one inference job by its HiveMind trace UUID.

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.game.ensure_available@v1
tools.description: Read-only check whether a game is locally available. Returns 'unavailable + remediation' when missing; never installs.

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.game_session.plan@v1
tools.description: Produce a dry-run game-streaming Plan. Probes cluster state when reachable; never reserves resources.

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.game_session.run@v1
tools.description: Walk the simulated game_session state machine. Phase 1 dry-run records 'would_call' evidence but never mutates.

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.game_session.status@v1
tools.description: Current state-machine position for a game_session job.

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.game_session.evidence@v1
tools.description: Per-phase evidence ledger for a game_session job.

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.game_session.cancel@v1
tools.description: Move a game_session job to CANCELLED. Idempotent.

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.gpu.passthrough.snapshot@v1
tools.description: Combined Ms4GpuPassthroughSnapshot.v1: capabilities + vm.gpus + vgpu_status + availability + per-mode (GPU-P/DDA/vGPU) availability/licensing notes.

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.gpu.passthrough.prepare@v1
tools.description: Switch a GPU to 'passthrough' (Hyper-V DDA path; consumer rebind works, VM attach needs Windows Server license) or 'vgpu' (NVIDIA vGPU stack).

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.gpu.passthrough.vgpu@v1
tools.description: Create one or more vGPU mediated device (mdev) instances on a GPU.

tools.name: ms4.hivemind.gpu.passthrough.game_stream_vm@v1
tools.description: Provision a Windows 11 GPU-P game-streaming VM via vm.create_prebuilt(windows_game_stream_prebuilt) + vm.deploy. Consumer-licensed.
